dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new safeguards decision, verified weapons-grade production, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. IAEA public news and press pages remained HTTP 403; reachable UN feeds added no Iranian nuclear threshold. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq recorded drone attacks on Monday during the direct U.S.-Iran strike pause. Saudi Arabia said it intercepted drones aimed at petroleum targets and attributed some to an Iran-backed militia launching from Iraq; other drone origins remain unidentified. Iranian state media separately claimed six unauthorized ships were turned back in Hormuz, one after an accident. A third strike-free night and Oman mediation continue, but Tehran denies requesting direct U.S. talks and still restricts the Strait. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: No distinct post-12Z mass-casualty event, Hezbollah strategic escalation or withdrawal timetable was verified. A freshly indexed framework headline traced to the already-signed 27 June arrangement rather than a new agreement; current U.S.-supported talks and Israeli operations continue. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Turkey's foreign minister continued mediation calls with Qatari and Pakistani counterparts, while a single analytical outlet described renewal of the Somalia mandate. No verified new Turkish combat entry, unusual concentration, missile-range test or official nuclear threshold appeared. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: India-Pakistan Kashmir rhetoric sharpened and local reporting described search operations after suspected drone sightings near the international border and Line of Control. No confirmed cross-border fire, drone attribution, interstate strike or unusual force concentration was verified. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh state-on-state strike, sustained border clash, crossing closure or unusual force movement was corroborated. Current anti-Taliban resistance claims and Pakistan militant violence do not establish a new interstate threshold. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN News opened a Security Council briefing on deadly Russian strikes hitting Ukrainian cities and ports, while reporting also described continuing reciprocal drone attacks. The high-intensity war persists without a verified nuclear-posture change or direct NATO combat threshold. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's defence ministry reported a drone briefly entered Romanian airspace on a fourth consecutive day; two F-16s scrambled, but the drone returned toward Ukraine and was not shot down. Romania then summoned Russia's ambassador, expelled an embassy employee and recalled its own ambassador after investigators identified Russian-origin debris. NATO's official feed lists no Article 4 or Article 5 consultation. Raw 58; coupled 68

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling-day review added commentary and regional exercises rather than a new PLA operation. The latest operational count remains seven PLAN vessels and four Chinese official ships around Taiwan; no blockade, amphibious concentration, expanded live-fire operation or direct clash was verified. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: South Korea continues monitoring the claim that Russia could receive 30,000 more North Korean troops, while the Kremlin disputes it. Reports about battlefield feedback on North Korean missiles add context but no verified new deployment, launcher movement, operational launch or prohibited-test event. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Agenzia Fides joined current reporting that the SAF reopened the Khartoum-el-Obeid axis, but battlefield control still rests primarily on army-origin reporting and no independent RSF response or reversal was verified. The strategic advance remains reflected at 94. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current reporting added Gaza casualties while continuing to cover the already-counted West Bank mosque arson and raids. Reachable UN News remained focused on severe dialysis-access constraints; no implemented truce or distinct strategic military threshold appeared. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change appeared in reachable official feeds or the rolling-day review. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh M23 territorial capture, mass recruitment announcement, direct Rwanda-DRC clash or verified infrastructure attack appeared in reachable UN feeds or rolling-day reporting. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports the Houthis claimed strikes on transit sites carrying oil toward Yanbu as Saudi Arabia intercepted drones aimed at petroleum targets; no new damage was independently verified. Separate Reuters-based shipping coverage says Bab el-Mandeb traffic has fallen sharply after already-counted attacks. The fresh attempt confirms persistent risk but does not establish a new loss or strategic threshold. Raw 87; coupled 87

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current analysis still describes separatist coordination with al-Qaeda-linked militants, but no independently verified post-12Z battle, strategic seizure, casualty total or new foreign deployment appeared. Raw 39; coupled 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh reporting covered the U.S.-Japan-Philippines exercise, policy statements and a civilian Vietnamese ship sinking. No new China-Philippines collision, hostile injury, vessel seizure, blockade or treaty consultation was verified. Raw 30; coupled 30

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling review added analysis of renewed piracy but no second hijacking, casualty, rescue or naval engagement. Current operational reporting still concerns the already-seized M/T Asana and its crew. Raw 28; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Thai Examiner reports four gunmen ambushed and wounded an off-duty police sergeant in Pattani on 26 July; he returned fire and survived, while security forces expanded checkpoints, roadblocks and patrols. The attack confirms persistent insurgent activity but adds no strategic or cross-border shift. Raw 25; coupled 25

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Abdali crossing reopening remains the latest verified operational change. No new hostile-drone strike, casualty, attribution or renewed closure appeared; post-12Z indexing was analysis of the same incident. Raw 17; coupled 17
